```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(targets)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

config     <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path("metadata/project_config.yaml"))
sc_entries <- config$subclusters
umap_name  <- "umap.nn"

# Consistent sample.name palette across all plots.
# Colours chosen per condition: WT = blue, Het/mCh- = green, mCh+ = orange.
# Stroma only has WT and Het (no mCh split).
sample_pal <- c(
  "Stroma_WT"          = "#4393c3",
  "Stroma_Het"         = "#d6604d",
  "CD41+_HSC_WT"       = "#4393c3",
  "CD41+ HSC_Het_mCh-" = "#74c476",
  "CD41+_HSC_Het_mCh+" = "#fd8d3c",
  "MNC_WT"             = "#4393c3",
  "MNC_mCh-"           = "#1a9850",
  "MNC_mCh+"           = "#d73027"
)
```

Layout per sub-cluster:

1. **Overview row** — UMAP of re-processed sub-cluster coloured by `sample.name`
   + stacked % bar showing proportion and cell count per sample.
2. **Per-sample silhouette rows** — for each `sample.name` present:
   - *Left*: cells of that sample highlighted on the **sub-cluster** UMAP
     (grey = other sub-cluster cells).
   - *Right*: cells of that sample highlighted on the **parent compartment** UMAP
     (grey = all other parent cells).

```{r helpers}
# ── Pie chart: % + n per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Works on a Seurat object OR a data.frame with sample.name column.
plot_sample_pie <- function(x, cols, title = "") {
  snames <- if (inherits(x, "Seurat")) x$sample.name else x$sample.name
  df <- as.data.frame(table(sample = snames)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct   = 100 * Freq / sum(Freq),
                  label = sprintf("%d\n%.1f%%", Freq, pct))

  ggplot(df, aes("", pct, fill = sample)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              size = 2.8, colour = "white", fontface = "bold",
              lineheight = 0.9) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y", start = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, drop = TRUE) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Sample") +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          legend.text      = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title       = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
}

# ── Silhouette: highlight one sample on an embedding ────────────────────────
# emb_src: either a Seurat object (uses Embeddings()) or a data.frame with
#          UMAP1/UMAP2 and cell_id columns (from anno_meta_*).
plot_highlight <- function(emb_src, fg_cells, colour, reduction = NULL, title = "") {
  if (inherits(emb_src, "Seurat")) {
    emb <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(emb_src, reduction))
    colnames(emb) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
    emb$cell_id <- rownames(emb)
  } else {
    emb <- emb_src[, c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2")]
    colnames(emb) <- c("cell_id", "UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  }
  emb$highlight  <- emb$cell_id %in% fg_cells

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = emb[!emb$highlight, ],
               aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
               colour = "grey88", size = 0.35, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = emb[emb$highlight, ],
               aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
               colour = colour, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid  = element_blank(),
          axis.text   = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
          plot.title  = element_text(size = 9))
}
```

```{r plots, results="asis"}
compartments <- unique(vapply(sc_entries, `[[`, "", "compartment"))

# Pre-load all anno_meta flat tables (UMAP coords only — no Seurat needed for parent context).
bg_meta <- list(
  stroma = { targets::tar_load(anno_meta_stroma); anno_meta_stroma },
  hsc    = { targets::tar_load(anno_meta_hsc);    anno_meta_hsc    },
  mnc    = { targets::tar_load(anno_meta_mnc);    anno_meta_mnc    }
)
rm(anno_meta_stroma, anno_meta_hsc, anno_meta_mnc)

for (comp in compartments) {
  comp_entries <- Filter(function(e) e$compartment == comp, sc_entries)
  bg_df <- bg_meta[[comp]]   # data.frame: cell_id, UMAP1, UMAP2, sample.name, ...

  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", toupper(comp)))
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

  for (entry in comp_entries) {
    target_name <- paste0("mpn_subclust_", entry$name)
    clust_label <- paste("Cluster", paste(unlist(entry$clusters), collapse = ", "))
    cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", clust_label))

    tar_load_raw(target_name)
    fg_srt  <- get(target_name)
    rm(list = target_name)

    present <- unique(fg_srt$sample.name)
    cols    <- sample_pal[intersect(names(sample_pal), present)]

    # ── Row 1: overview UMAP + pie ──────────────────────────────────
    p_umap <- plot_umap_groups(fg_srt,
                               group_i      = "sample.name",
                               cols         = cols,
                               reduction    = umap_name,
                               legend_title = "Sample") +
      labs(title = "Sub-cluster re-processed") +
      theme(plot.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
            legend.position  = "top",
            legend.direction = "horizontal",
            legend.text      = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"))

    p_pie <- plot_sample_pie(fg_srt, cols,
                             title = sprintf("n = %d cells", ncol(fg_srt)))

    cat("```{=html}\n<div style='margin-bottom:6px'></div>\n```\n\n")
    fig_overview <- p_umap + p_pie + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))
    print(fig_overview)
    cat("\n\n")

    # ── Row 2+: per-sample silhouettes ──────────────────────────────
    # fg cell IDs in sub-cluster; bg_df provides parent embedding.
    fg_cells_all <- colnames(fg_srt)

    for (sname in present) {
      colour      <- sample_pal[[sname]]
      sname_short <- gsub("CD41[+_]+", "", sname)  # trim for title
      cells_sub   <- colnames(fg_srt)[fg_srt$sample.name == sname]
      # parent context: sub-cluster cells of this sample in parent embedding
      cells_par_fg <- intersect(cells_sub, bg_df$cell_id)

      p_sil_sub <- plot_highlight(fg_srt, cells_sub, colour,
                                  reduction = umap_name,
                                  title     = sprintf("%s — sub-cluster", sname_short))

      p_sil_par <- plot_highlight(bg_df, cells_par_fg, colour,
                                  title     = sprintf("%s — in %s context",
                                                      sname_short, toupper(comp)))

      print(p_sil_sub | p_sil_par)
      cat("\n\n")
    }

    rm(fg_srt); gc()
  }

  cat(":::\n\n")
}
rm(bg_meta); gc()
```
